bloomberg.title: Bloomberg Terminal & Port
bloomberg.description: Import user-exported Bloomberg trade files into the existing Multi-Asset CDM. Decimal.js precision 40 keeps financial values exact through parsing and mapping.
bloomberg.signInTitle: Sign in to use the authenticated importer
bloomberg.signInDescription: No file or portfolio data is sent while browsing in preview mode.
bloomberg.thbRequired: The current Multi-Asset valuation engines require a THB-base portfolio for Bloomberg imports.
bloomberg.sizeLimit: Up to 10 MB. Save legacy .xls as .xlsx or CSV before upload.
bloomberg.chooseFileHint: Select a local CSV, TSV, or .xlsx file. The original file is not retained.
bloomberg.ruleFields: Requires trade date, ticker, side, quantity, price, and currency.
bloomberg.ruleFx: Non-THB trades need an explicit FX Rate to THB.
bloomberg.ruleUnsupported: Futures are rejected; options and warrants need full contract terms.
bloomberg.rowsParsed: {count} rows parsed · CDM payloads saved to {portfolio}.
bloomberg.actionsNotice: Splits, dividends, spin-offs, mergers, and tender events are parsed for review but are not persisted or applied to FIFO lots.
bloomberg.tickerParserDescription: Enter a Bloomberg ticker to inspect its security symbol, market, and asset suffix. The same parser is used by the authenticated import API.
bloomberg.suffixNotice: All Bloomberg asset suffixes are recognized. Futures are explicitly rejected during CDM import because the protected CDM has no separate futures contract type.
bloomberg.portNotice: Sandbox is an empty mock. There is no verified Port API contract, credential vault, or live network connector configured in this repository.
bloomberg.noCredentials: No API key or secret is requested, transmitted, or stored by this stub.
bloomberg.liveStep1: Verify Bloomberg Port API documentation and entitlements.
bloomberg.liveStep2: Implement reviewed OAuth/signing and encrypted secret storage.
bloomberg.liveStep3: Add read-only scopes, audit logs, and a disconnect/purge flow.
bloomberg.compatibilityNotice: Bloomberg export-file compatibility only; no official Bloomberg partnership or live Terminal/Port connection is claimed.

wallet.badge: Cross-chain DeFi & cold wallet sync • Read-only
wallet.title: Connect crypto wallets across chains (EVM • Solana • Bitcoin)
wallet.description: Import token balances (ERC-20, SPL, native) and convert DEX swaps (e.g., USDT → ETH) into FIFO accounting automatically (separate SELL + BUY + gas FEE legs, calculated with Decimal.js precision 40).
wallet.securityTitle: We never ask for a private key or seed phrase.
wallet.securityDescription: Only public blockchain addresses are connected (100% read-only). Private keys and mnemonics are automatically detected and blocked. Wallet addresses are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and paired with a SHA-256 hash before storage.
wallet.addressLabel: Public wallet address (chain auto-detected from format)
wallet.addressPlaceholder: Paste a public address, e.g. 0x71C7…, 9xQeWv…, or bc1qxy…
wallet.blockedSeed: Automatic block: a seed phrase / mnemonic was detected. Never enter it; use only a public wallet address.
wallet.blockedPrivateKey: Automatic block: a private / secret key pattern was detected. Never enter it; use only a public address.
wallet.invalidAddress: Invalid public wallet address format (supports EVM 0x…, Solana SPL, and Bitcoin bc1…/1…/3…).
wallet.chainMismatch: Address format matches {detected}, not the selected {selected}.
wallet.checkingAddress: Checking public address format (EVM 0x, 42 characters / Solana Base58 / Bitcoin bc1q)…
wallet.emptyWallets: No crypto wallets connected yet. Paste a public wallet address or choose a sample above to start read-only on-chain sync.
wallet.neverSynced: No on-chain transactions synced yet — select Sync on-chain data to import swaps and transfers.
wallet.syncSuccess: Sync complete! Found {discovered} on-chain transactions → converted to {generated} CDM records.
wallet.breakdown: BUY {buy} • SELL {sell} • Gas FEE {fees} • Duplicates skipped: {skipped}
wallet.errorFallback: Could not complete the wallet request. Please try again.

consent.title: Data privacy consent — connect {broker}
consent.heading: Personal data protection consent (Thailand PDPA B.E. 2562)
consent.purpose: Masked account references and trade/dividend history are used only to sync portfolios, calculate FIFO, and show tax information.
consent.access: Only provider-approved read endpoints are used. The system cannot place or cancel trades or withdraw funds. Create read-only credentials with your broker.
consent.storage: API keys and tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage and are never written to application logs. Synced transactions remain in the portfolio until you delete them or use purge.
consent.withdraw: “Disconnect & Purge Data” immediately deletes credentials and records from this connector. Minimal append-only audit metadata is retained; manually imported records are not deleted.
consent.privacyNotice: Before live activation, attach a complete privacy notice stating the data controller, contact channel, retention period, processors/transfers, and data-subject rights under PDPA. This screen is a consent flow for testing and demonstration.
consent.checkbox: I acknowledge and consent to read-only data connection for the purposes above.
consent.bitkubSecret: Bitkub read-only API secret (encrypted with AES-256-GCM immediately)
consent.dimeToken: Dime! read-only partner OAuth token (leave blank for statement automation)
consent.consentRequired: Please accept the personal data protection (PDPA) consent before connecting.
